name: hub
//: PULSE hub UI - the owner's console. Next.js App Router + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui, exported statically to out/ which the Go binary embeds (web/hub/dist.go, //go:embed all:out). out/ is committed on purpose: go build needs no Node.
dev:        `npm run dev` on :3000 proxies /api/* to the Go hub - run `pulse hub --no-browser --port 8787` first (PULSE_HUB_PORT overrides the port).
dev:mock:   `npm run dev:mock` runs mock/server.mjs (fixtures in mock/api/**.json, writes answered in memory, SSE at /api/v1/events/stream) on :8787 and next dev on :3000. No hub needed.

build:      `npm run build` = static export to out/ (commit out/ after UI changes). `npm run serve:out` serves out/ plus the mock API on :8787 (the same layout the Go hub serves) for a last look at the export.
check:      `npm run lint` (eslint) and `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit). All API calls are relative /api/v1/...; the TypeScript contract lives in src/lib/api.ts.
routes:     / (hub), /project/?slug=&tab=, /tasks/, /records/?id=, /compute/, /settings/, /agents/ - state in search params, no dynamic segments.

scripts.dev:mock: node mock/server.mjs & MOCK=$!; PULSE_HUB_PORT=${PULSE_HUB_PORT:-8787} next dev; kill $MOCK
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
